entries.basis: Shipped guarded :has enhancement and vh/dvh fallbacks have documented baseline behavior, with no anchor positioning/style-query/view-transition dependency. The exact outstanding fallback and four-presentation branches now pass three engines.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-C-14 Reconcile original `C-14`: Define progressive enhancement with `@supports`; do not adopt limited-support anchor positioning, style queries, or transitions as unconditional dependencies. Historical status: open.

entries.basis: Owned focus-visible/native attributes retain baseline outlines; decorated-field unsupported-enhancement and empty-grid focus-repair cases now pass, including inset/forced-color checks. Accepted keyboard/focus lifecycle and rendered visual matrix cover representative replaced outlines without claiming all-state/device coverage.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-C-15 Reconcile original `C-15`: Use `:focus-visible` or owned accessible focus-state attributes; preserve visible focus when replacing current outline suppression. Historical status: open.

limits: Unsupported-has branch injection in current engines is not an old-browser support floor claim. Forced-color ring assertions and retained visual review are not spoken AT or physical dynamic-viewport acceptance. Optional native nesting remains deferred separately.
